problem_type: Indirect canvas writes must retain their owning proposal context
symptom: Confirming a storyboard saved its plan but removed its new shot table and caused another confirmation request.
direct_cause: setStoryboardPlan calls ensureStoryboardShotTable; addNode without the proposal context interrupts and compensates its own pending proposal.
class_root: The semantic tool boundary treated storyboard owner writes as canvas-free although explicit plan writes now project a canvas view.
affected_population: Every approved propose_storyboard_plan and patch_shots operation with a missing storyboard table
internal_only_reason: The invariant is enforced by the existing in-process canvasGestureContext and canvasWriteBoundary; no external API or dependency behavior changed.
invariants: All synchronous canvas effects of an approved semantic tool retain its proposalId, including effects reached through another store.
generality_proof: Both storyboard-writing branches use the same existing inCtx synchronous boundary as all other canvas mutations; the proposal guard remains strict and needs no exception.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Bind the approved proposal gesture to all synchronous plan-to-canvas writes.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Repository scan found this direct setStoryboardPlan call outside inCtx; the call can create the table and project existing shot nodes.
Repository scan found this direct setStoryboardPlan call outside inCtx; the call can create the table and project existing shot nodes.

recurrence.reason: Both semantic storyboard operations can create a table from any plan or project, so repeated user approvals encounter the same pending-write cancellation.
same_class_scan: rg setStoryboardPlan src/workbench/generationCanvas/agent/applyCanvasToolCall.ts: patch_shots and propose_storyboard_plan independently inspected
rg inCtx src/workbench/generationCanvas/agent/applyCanvasToolCall.ts: direct canvas actions already preserve context

prevention.invariant: Owner writes and their synchronous canvas projection execute under the active semantic tool gesture.
prevention.failure_mode: Existing canWrite/pending proposal guards still reject foreign or stale writes.
prevention.strategy: Use the existing inCtx boundary for both storyboard writes; do not relax canvasWriteBoundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: No alternate implementation exists; the two unscoped calls are replaced in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal mutation ownership, no third-party lifecycle involved.

migration: No persisted data migration; explicit writes retain existing source-only shot-table metadata.
residual_risks: The full one-window replay stopped on a platform-dependent zoom action; same-profile continuation verified the remaining UI assertions. See docs/audit/2026-09-10-shot-table-storyboard-walk.md.
